The published thresholds table, from a tuning run's outputs

Source: R/thresholds_table.R
knw_thresholds_table.Rd

One row per species × stage × component of the joint pick, in the columns link's calibration reads (link#346): rule_id ties the components of one rule; link_parameter is the column of link's parameters_habitat_thresholds.csv the value fills, where one exists (the near-a-river exception has none in link and is NA); model says whether the size test is a width (cw) or a MAD (mad) floor; range_lo and range_hi are the smallest and largest value of the component among the rules inside the one-SE region on the main reading; readings_in is the number of fold seeds (the main one and the extra seeds) in whose region the recommended rule sits, of readings. A species × stage that was not fitted (no stream rule, no response, too few groups) gets one row per stage with status saying why and no values.

Usage

knw_thresholds_table(
  tune_dir,
  evidence_version,
  link_run_uid,
  link_sha,
  config = "default"
)

Arguments

tune_dir

character(1) the directory scripts/0320 wrote (one <sp>_<stage>_summary.csv per species × stage, bound here).

evidence_version, link_run_uid, link_sha, config

character(1) the provenance every row carries.

Value

A list: thresholds and groups (one row per rule_id and watershed group the rule was scored on), both tibbles.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
t <- knw_thresholds_table("data/tune", "knowledge/fdis/v3", "20261017_004619-3f4c713b", "a17e9177", "default")
t$thresholds
} # }
